verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is an open-source library with a self-hostable Docker/FastAPI deployment, so crawled data stays on infrastructure the user runs and controls. Persistent browser profiles (cookies, auth state) are user-managed. Neither is documented as an explicit retention or deletion feature. missing for 10: documented retention/deletion controls (e.g., cache clearing, profile/session deletion, TTLs), explicit privacy/data-handling docs, independent corroboration.
